settings.heading: Quick answers, sorted by topic.
settings.text: Browse products, shipping, orders and returns, or write to the care team.

settings.question: Which skin types are these formulas made for?
settings.answer: All of them. Each skin product is fragrance-free and tested on sensitive, dry and oily skin.

settings.question: Are the products vegan and cruelty-free?
settings.answer: Yes. Nothing contains animal-derived ingredients and nothing is tested on animals.

settings.question: Can I use them while pregnant?
settings.answer: Our formulas avoid retinoids and strong acids, but check with your doctor about anything you apply daily.

settings.question: How fast will my order arrive?
settings.answer: Orders leave within one to three business days. Domestic delivery takes about three to four more.

settings.question: Do you ship to Canada and Europe?
settings.answer: Yes. Canadian orders include duties at checkout. Delivery windows for each region show before you pay.

settings.question: What is the return window?
settings.answer: Contact us within thirty days of delivery and we will start a return or exchange.

settings.question: Where is it safe to buy?
settings.answer: Only on our site, our official social shops and a few named retail partners. Anywhere else may sell fakes.
